Last updated: 2026-11-23. This file and the code are the record. If they ever disagree, the tests fail.

## 2. Where everything lives

| Thing | File(s) |
| --- | --- |
| Level settings: official format, timing, which sets each level has, mock layout | `src/content/levels.ts` |
| Question types and shared fields (every question says `sourceType: 'original'`) | `src/content/types.ts` |
| HSK 2 practice sets A–C | `src/content/sets/set-a.ts`, `set-b.ts`, `set-c.ts` |
| HSK 2 picture sets (Reading Part 1) | `src/content/sets/pictures-a.ts` |
| HSK 1 practice sets A–C | `src/content/hsk1/set-a.ts`, `set-b.ts`, `set-c.ts` |
| Photos and recordings register (credit, licence, checksum for every file) | `src/content/media.ts`, files in `public/media/` |
| Outside sources and licences (shown on the Sources & Licences screen) | `src/content/sources.ts` |
| Dictionary, level tags, character lists, stroke data | `public/packs/` (built by `scripts/build-data/build-all.mjs` from `data-raw/`) |
| How papers and mock exams are put together | `src/features/exam/papers.ts` |

Question ids say where a question lives:
- `b-r3-2` is HSK 2, set B, Reading Part 3, question 2.
- `h1-a-p2-1` is HSK 1, set A, Part 2, question 1.
- `p1a-r1-4` is HSK 2, picture set 1 (`p1a`), Reading Part 1, question 4.

A mistake, a backup or a test failure that names an id points straight to the file and question.

## 3. Chinese accuracy (HSK standards)

**The standards used:**
- **Words and characters:** the official HSK 3.0 syllabus (中文水平考试 HSK 考试大纲, CTI, published 2025-11, in effect 2026-07). The data build reads its word lists, reading-character lists, syllabus pinyin and the 书写字 writing list.
- **Exam format:** CTI's official sample papers HSK（一级）样卷 and HSK（二级）样卷 (2026). These set the question types, part order, number of questions and timing. Third-party summaries are not used.
- **Pinyin and meanings:** CC-CEDICT. Where a character has several readings, the build marks the one the syllabus uses.

**What the tests enforce on every question** (`tests/unit/content.test.ts`, `tests/unit/pinyin-content.test.ts`):
1. **Level-only Chinese:** only characters from the level's syllabus lists, plus the characters of the level's syllabus words. The only exceptions are a few names (王, 李, 北京) and the radicals offered in Writing Part 1.
2. **Pinyin:**
   - every syllable matches a dictionary reading of its character;
   - each HSK word uses the reading the syllabus lists (猫 must be māo, not the rare máo);
   - tone changes are only allowed for 一/不 and neutral tones.
3. **Official shape:** right number of questions per part, and one unused option in every shared list (word bank, replies, pictures).
4. **Mixed answers:** neighbouring questions never have neighbouring letters (A then B…), so answers can't be guessed from the order.
5. **Valid answers:** every answer points to a real option, and Writing Part 2 answers come from the official writing list.
6. **No repeats:** no question appears twice, in either level.
7. **Honest labels:**
   - every question is marked original;
   - questions are labelled with the syllabus version;
   - every question has an explanation.

Every checker has been proven against a planted mistake (wrong tone, above-level word, duplicate answer, unregistered file, changed photo).

**Checked by hand, every time** (tests can't judge these):
- **Only one right answer:** each question has one correct answer, not two. Word banks and reply lists are where this went wrong before.
- **Natural Chinese:** sentences must sound like something a person would really say.
- **Correct explanations:** grammar explanations must be accurate.
- **Clear pictures:** each photo shows one clear thing, and nothing else in the same question could also match.

## 4. Copyright and licences

**The app's own code:** GPL-3.0-or-later. This is required because it includes HanziLookupJS, which is GPL.

**Practice questions:** all original, written for this app. No official HSK questions, pictures, recordings or scripts are copied.

**Outside sources:** each one is listed with its licence in `src/content/sources.ts`, and shown on the app's Sources & Licences screen.

| Source | Licence | What it allows / requires |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CC-CEDICT | CC BY-SA 4.0 | Credit, and our filtered copy is shared under the same licence. |
| HanziLookupJS | GPL (code), Arphic Public License (data) | The app's source must stay open (it is, on GitHub). |
| Hanzi Writer | MIT | Keep the copyright notice. |
| hanzi-writer-data / Make Me a Hanzi | Arphic Public License | Keep the licence text (bundled at `public/vendor/hanzilookup/LICENSE-APL.txt`). |
| Inter, Fraunces fonts | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | Free to bundle; fonts can't be sold on their own. |
| React, Dexie, Workbox | MIT, Apache-2.0, MIT | Keep the notices. |
| Unsplash photos | Unsplash License | Free use without permission or credit. Not allowed: selling photos unchanged, or compiling them into a rival photo service. Only free photos, never Unsplash+. |
| HSK syllabus (CTI) | Copyright CTI, no open licence | **Known risk.** Used only for level tags and character lists, with a citation. The document itself isn't redistributed. CTI hasn't been asked for permission. |
| HSK sample papers (CTI) | Copyright CTI | Used only to learn the format. Nothing from them is in the app. |

**What the tests enforce** (`tests/unit/media-and-licences.test.ts`):
- **Every file is registered:** every file in `public/media/` has an entry in the register, and every entry's file exists.
- **No silent changes:** each file's checksum must match the register.
- **Full credits:** every entry has an author, source page, approved licence, download date and description of changes.
- **No unused files:** every registered picture is used by a question, and the register has no leftovers.
- **Approved licences only:** every package shipped to users has an approved licence (MIT, Apache-2.0, OFL-1.1, ISC, BSD) and is credited on the Sources & Licences screen.

**Never use:**
- official CTI questions, audio, pictures or scripts;
- Unsplash+ or other paid stock photos;
- pictures found through general image search;
- photos with visible brands, logos or writing;
- free voice tools whose terms forbid this use or require credits we don't give.

## 5. Rules for adding photos and recordings

**Adding a photo:**
1. Write the question first, then find a photo where only one sentence in the group can match. Avoid logos and writing.
2. Use free Unsplash photos, and check the page says "Free Photo on Unsplash", not Unsplash+. Pexels or Pixabay need their licence added to `MEDIA_LICENCES` first, after reading their current terms.
3. Download a resized copy into `public/media/photos/` named after the source id. For Unsplash, use `https://images.unsplash.com/photo-…?w=800&h=600&fit=crop&q=60&fm=jpg`.
4. Add an entry to `src/content/media.ts` with:
   - a description of what the picture shows, in English, with no Chinese;
   - the source page and the author with their profile link;
   - the licence and the download date;
   - what was changed;
   - the file's SHA-256 (`shasum -a 256 <file>`).
5. Run `npm test`. It fails until the register, the file and the question all agree.

**Adding recordings (not built yet):**
- **Computer voices** (for example Azure or Google neural voices):
  - read and note that provider's current terms before generating anything;
  - label the audio in the app as a computer voice;
  - keep the API key on the computer that generates the audio, never in the repository;
  - listen to every clip for wrong readings (行, 了, 得…).
- **A person's voice:** get their written permission first, covering use in the app, the public website and the public GitHub repository.
- **For both:** register each audio file in `src/content/media.ts` like a photo, with a new `kind` and licence entry.

## 6. What isn't verified yet

- **Native-speaker review:** no question has been reviewed by a native speaker. They're checked by the author and by the tests above.
- **Pass marks:** CTI hasn't published pass marks or scaled scores for the new HSK 1–6, so the app shows raw scores only.
- **Missing parts:**
  - Listening;
  - HSK 1 Reading Part 1;
  - Reading Part 1 inside the mock exams. It needs at least 3 picture sets, so each mock can use different pictures.
- **Real devices:** not yet tested on a real iPhone, Safari or Firefox.
- **CTI permission:** not yet asked (see the table above).

## 7. How to check everything

```bash
npm test
```

```bash
npm run test:e2e
```

- `npm test` runs the content, pinyin, media, licence and inventory checks, plus everything else. Expect 0 failures.
- `npm run test:e2e` runs every screen in a real browser, on desktop and phone sizes, including offline.
